storeSettings.returnPolicy:
Some of our garments feature well-loved heirloom textiles or vintage elements that have been hand-picked from across America. They include wear, distress, marks and other minor signs of a previous life well lived that adds to the natural patina and character of these one-of-a-kind pieces. These items are sold as is and wont be accepted as returns unless it’s deemed there is a fault with the manufacturing of any new elements.

All other products that aren’t from our one-of-a-kind selection are able to be happily returned within 14 days of ship date for an exchange or refund to your original form of payment minus shipping fees.

To initiate a return or exchange please visit our return center HERE. You’ll need your order number including the 0 EG: 02334 and your email.

Any damaged returns that don’t pass our warehouse quality control protocol will not be refunded and shipped back at the customers expense.

We are not liable for lost packages once shipped.

All international customers are responsible for any import taxes and duties associated with their country. Any packages not collected by customer or sent back due to non-payment will be assed and refunded to the customer on return to sender minus any associated fees accumulated. Lost packages on return journey due to customer not accepting or paying import charges will not be refunded.

Sale items are considered final sale and are not eligible for return or exchange.
